title: Marathon Clock
description: 12-minute EMOM followed by a 12-minute AMRAP to push your endurance to the limit

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width, lower until thighs are parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Feet elevated on a chair, body braced

exercises.name: Squat jumps
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a maximum jump, absorb the landing

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.instructions: Step forward continuously in walking lunges

exercises.name: Commando push-ups
exercises.instructions: Alternate between plank position and push-up position

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift the straight legs to vertical

exercises.name: Jump squats
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a jump, absorb the landing

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
